name: Franchise India Expo 2027 (International Franchise & Retail Show)
venue_name: Yashobhoomi (IICC), India International Convention and Expo Centre, Dwarka
audience: Investors, entrepreneurs and business owners looking for franchise, dealership and distribution businesses; pavilions include Dealer India / National Dealer & Distribution, SME Expo and Future-Tech & D2C
footfall_text: "50000+ VISITORS WITH CLEAR INVESTMENT INTENTION"; body text says the show will "reach 40,000+ qualified verified buyers" (organiser claim)
exhibit_options: Stalls in themed pavilions, including the Dealer India pavilion ("Book a Stall"). Sponsorship by enquiry; past tiers were Title, Associate, Session, Welcome Kit and Gifting Partner. Speaking slots at the co-located Bharat Startup Summit 2027. Stall and sponsorship prices are not published. The registration page lists visitor passes at ₹1,500 (1 day) and a ₹7,000 Premium Pass.
why_fit: India's biggest gathering of people shopping for a dealership, franchise or distribution business. Its Dealer India pavilion targets would-be dealers, and its listed sectors include telecom/IT and software services.

name: FROEXPO 2026 Gujarat (146th Franchise & Retail Opportunity Expo) + Bharat Startup Summit Gujarat
audience: Potential investors and business seekers looking to partner with franchise and retail brands; the co-located startup summit adds startups and SMEs
footfall_text: "2 Days. 200+ Brands. 8,000+ Investors." / "8000+ Potential Investors" (organiser claim)
exhibit_options: Stalls ("Book Your Stall") and sponsorship, prices not published. The co-located Bharat Startup Summit offers attend, speak and exhibit options.
why_fit: Regional franchise show that pulls in Gujarat entrepreneurs who are actively shopping for a new business line. It is the earliest one in the window.

name: FRO Expo 2026 Chandigarh (147th Franchise & Retail Opportunity Expo)
venue_name: Hotel Park Plaza, Zirakpur (the event page also shows "Hotel TAJ, Chandigarh" and old Dec 2025 dates, so confirm)
audience: Business buyers and HNI investors from the Chandigarh/Punjab/Haryana region looking for franchise opportunities
footfall_text: "5000+ Business Buyers" / "5,000+ Potential Investors"; banner says "1000 + HNI Investors" (organiser claim)
exhibit_options: Stalls ("BOOK A STALL") and sponsorship, prices not published
why_fit: The only franchise and business-opportunity show in the north-west Tier-2 belt during the window.
source_name: FRO Expo Chandigarh event page (Franchise India)

name: FROEXPO 2027 Pune (148th Franchise & Retail Opportunity Expo)
audience: Potential investors and business seekers looking to partner with franchise and retail brands
footfall_text: "2 Days. 100+ Brands. 5,000+ Investors." / "5000+ Potential Investors" (organiser claim)
exhibit_options: Stalls ("Book a Stall") and sponsorship, prices not published
why_fit: Pune entrepreneurs looking for a new business, held about three weeks after CMDA Pune. The team could follow up there with the same regional pitch.

name: FROEXPO 2027 Jaipur (149th Franchise & Retail Opportunity Expo)
audience: Potential investors and business seekers looking to partner with franchise and retail brands
footfall_text: "2 Days. 100+ Brands. 5,000+ Investors." / "5000+ Potential Investors" (organiser claim)
exhibit_options: Stalls ("Book a Stall") and sponsorship, prices not published
why_fit: Rajasthan's main business-opportunity show, attended by local entrepreneurs who want to add a dealership or franchise.

name: FRO Expo 2027 Hyderabad (150th Franchise & Retail Opportunity Expo)
audience: Potential investors and business seekers looking to partner with franchise and retail brands
footfall_text: "2 Days. 200+ Brands. 8,000+ Investors." / "8,000+ Potential Investors" (organiser claim)
exhibit_options: Stalls ("Book a Stall") and sponsorship, prices not published. Visitor options are Friday, Saturday, both days or a Premium Pass (prices blank).

source_name: FRO Expo Hyderabad event page (Franchise India)

name: FROEXPO Chennai (Franchise & Retail Opportunity Expo)
month_hint: Usually late June (144th edition was 27–28 Jun 2026); 2027 dates not announced
audience: Potential investors and business seekers looking to partner with franchise and retail brands
footfall_text: "8000+ Potential Investors" / "8000+ Business Seekers" (organiser claim, 2026 edition)
exhibit_options: Stalls ("BOOK YOUR STALL") and sponsorship, prices not published
why_fit: Tamil Nadu's main franchise and business-opportunity show, attended by entrepreneurs looking for a new line of business.

name: FROEXPO Lucknow (Franchise & Retail Opportunity Expo)
month_hint: Usually July (145th edition was 18–19 Jul 2026; a Lucknow franchise expo was also held 21 Jul 2024); 2027 dates not announced
audience: Business seekers and potential investors from Uttar Pradesh looking for franchise and retail opportunities
footfall_text: "5000+ Potential Investors"; banner says "Showcase your Brands to 5000+ Business Seekers" (organiser claim, 2026 edition)
exhibit_options: Stalls ("Book Your Stall") and sponsorship, prices not published
why_fit: The only recurring business-opportunity show in UP, a large Tier-2 market where Vyapar needs resellers.

name: FREX Bengaluru – National Franchise and Retail Expo (listed in dashboard as "Fro Bangalaru")
month_hint: Usually August (2026 edition was 22–23 Aug 2026); 2027 dates not announced
audience: Entrepreneurs, investors, business owners and aspiring franchisees
why_fit: Karnataka franchise show, co-located with Bharat Startup Summit, where people looking for a new business gather.
source_name: Franchise India Insights – FREX Bengaluru 2026 Day 1 report

name: Brands Business Expo 2027 (dashboard: "The Brand Business Expo")
venue_name: Gujarat University Convention & Exhibition Centre, Memnagar
audience: Brands seeking retailers, distributors and franchise partners
footfall_text: The organiser site shows site-wide 2027 figures, not figures for this show: "15,000+" Trade Visitors, "800+" Exhibitors (organiser claim)
exhibit_options: Shell scheme (min 9 sq m) or raw space (min 18 sq m). Prices are on a 'Participation Charges' page and not shown in the fetched content.
why_fit: A multi-brand expo built around signing up distributors, dealers and franchise partners. NEW: the organiser now lists 17–19 Apr 2027, but the dashboard has 10–12 Apr.

name: BNI Ahmedabad Symposium (with Sicilian Expo)
month_hint: Annual flagship, usually May (2026 edition was 8–9 May); 2027 dates not announced
audience: Business leaders and entrepreneurs from 50+ industries (BNI members and guests); the expo is open to the public on day 2
footfall_text: "over 10,000 business leaders and entrepreneurs from more than 50 industries" (organiser claim, syndicated press release for 2026)
exhibit_options: Business exhibition of "over 150 stalls under the Sicilian Expo". Sponsorship exists: the 2026 edition was "presented by A. Shridhar and powered by Shyam Group". The source does not say whether non-members can take stalls, so confirm with BNI Ahmedabad. No prices published.
why_fit: The largest single gathering of BNI's referral-minded small-business owners in Gujarat, a good pool for side-business resellers.

name: JITO Connect (national summit of Jain International Trade Organisation)
organiser: Jain International Trade Organisation (JITO); 2025 edition hosted by JITO Hyderabad chapter
month_hint: Not annual: last edition 3–5 Oct 2025 (Hyderabad, first time there); next edition, city and dates not announced
audience: Jain business community nationwide: entrepreneurs, traders, startups and business families
footfall_text: "an anticipated footfall exceeding 2 lakh"; "over 50,000 changemakers" (organiser claim, pre-event)
exhibit_options: "over 1,000 business stalls" plus a startup showcase. Sponsorship exists: Holiday Bazar was title sponsor in 2025 and a jeweller was category sponsor. No prices published.
why_fit: India's biggest community business convention, where thousands of trading-family entrepreneurs gather in one place.
source_name: Business News Week – JITO Connect 2025 curtain raiser

name: Vyapaar Expo (Kolkata)
venue_name: Biswa Bangla Milan Mela, EM Bypass
month_hint: Annual, late Jan/early Feb (2026 edition was 30 Jan–1 Feb). A Neventum listing says the next edition is "Jan 2027 - Pending dates to confirm".
audience: Business owners, entrepreneurs, decision-makers and professionals, plus visitors from Tier-2 cities and investors
footfall_text: "A total of around 25000+ people is expected to visit the expo"; "Open Networking with thousands of entrepreneur" (organiser claim)
exhibit_options: "250+ Business Stalls" and sponsor categories, prices not published
why_fit: The only sizeable entrepreneur and business-networking expo found in East India. Its audience is business owners from Kolkata and nearby Tier-2 towns.
source_name: Vyapaar Expo (organiser site); dates from Neventum listing

name: Bharatiya Vyapar Mahotsav (Indian Business Expo)
organiser: ITPO and Confederation of All India Traders (CAIT)
month_hint: August (2026 edition was 12–15 Aug; the site also references a 2025 edition); 2027 dates not announced
audience: Traders, MSMEs, manufacturers, start-ups and women/rural entrepreneurs as B2B delegates (10am–7pm), plus public visitors (3–7pm)
footfall_text: "over 10+ lakh visitors, 2Lakh+ B2B delegates, and international buyers" (organiser claim)
exhibit_options: Stalls (rate card PDF linked on the site, not read). Sponsor and category-partner slots exist (e.g. Kent, Porter, Shriram Fin, Uno Minda, Hero).
why_fit: The largest gathering of CAIT's trader network. It is a lower fit because most attendees are Vyapar end-users rather than resellers, but it reaches many small-business entrepreneurs at once.
